article.story: Louisville (6-3) at North Carolina (5-4), Nov. 14 at 7 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Louisville by 2.5. Against the spread: Louisville 6-3, North Carolina 6-3. How to watch: ESPN2 Key stats Louisville Offense Overall: 488.1 yards per game (8th in FBS) Passing: 260.1 yards per game (31st) Rushing: 228.0 yards per game (8th) Scoring: 40.8 points per game (6th) Louisville Defense Overall: 404.4 yards per game (112th in FBS) Passing: 265.9 yards per game (130th) Rushing: 138.6 yards per game (66th) Scoring: 25.9 points per game (78th) North Carolina Offense Overall: 352.9 yards per game (100th in FBS) Passing: 238.7 yards per game (55th) Rushing: 114.2 yards per game (121st) Scoring: 27.1 points per game (75th) North Carolina Defense Overall: 377.0 yards per game (84th in FBS) Passing: 227.2 yards per game (91st) Rushing: 149.8 yards per game (78th) Scoring: 22.8 points per game (51st) North Carolina ranks 121st in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 44.1% of the time. Louisville ranks 33rd on offense, converting on 44.4% of third downs. North Carolina is 74th in the FBS with a -1 turnover margin, compared to Louisville's 14th-ranked +7 margin. Louisville ranks 124th in the FBS averaging 72.1 penalty yards per game, compared to North Carolina's 6th-ranked 34.3 per-game average. Louisville is 17th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 75.0% of red zone trips. Team leaders Louisville Passing: Lincoln Kienholz, 2,276 yards, 14 TDs, 3 INTs, 67.8 completion percentage Rushing: Isaac Brown, 745 yards on 99 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Tre Richardson, 685 yards on 44 catches, 3 TDs North Carolina Passing: Billy Edwards Jr., 2,126 yards, 18 TDs, 6 INTs, 65.2 completion percentage Rushing: Benjamin Hall, 377 yards on 69 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Jordan Shipp, 642 yards on 50 catches, 4 TDs Last game Louisville won 44-17 over Georgia Tech on Nov. 7. Kienholz threw for 182 yards on 17-of-25 attempts (68.0%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball nine times for 81 yards. Keyjuan Brown had 54 rushing yards on nine carries, adding two receptions for six yards. Treyshun Hurry had eight receptions for 104 yards and one touchdown. North Carolina won 38-21 over UConn on Nov. 7. Edwards threw for 255 yards on 29-of-38 attempts (76.3%) with three touchdowns and one interception. Hall carried the ball nine times for 81 yards and scored one touchdown, adding four receptions for 26 yards. Jelani Thurman had seven receptions for 64 yards and two touchdowns. Next game Louisville hosts Pittsburgh on Nov. 21. North Carolina plays at Virginia on Nov. 21.
